summary: Figure F3_dro illustrates the theoretical behavior of the χ²-DRO method applied to a binary success rate. It shows how the function g_ρ(p) changes with varying ρ and p_bar. The data indicates that as ρ increases, g_ρ also increases, reaching a maximum of 1.0. The rho_saturation values suggest the point at which the function reaches its upper bound.
observations: The mean value of rho is 0.12121, with a minimum of 0.00000 and a maximum of 1.00000.
The mean value of p_bar is 0.23515, with a minimum of 0.08905 and a maximum of 0.46974.
The mean value of g_rho is 0.35817, with a minimum of 0.08905 and a maximum of 1.00000.
The rho_saturation values range from 0.56442 to 5.11498, indicating the saturation point for different rho values.
caveats: The figure is in theory-mode and uses simulated inputs, so the results are not based on experimental data.
The sample size is large (200 rows), but the data is theoretical and may not reflect real-world scenarios.
